2421.headline: Tickets sold so far

2422.body:
"Platinum 7s" offers a top prize of $2 million and eleven prize levels in all. The prize money leans toward the smaller prizes. Games shaped like this give out wins often, but rarely large ones. This design never changes, while every other number on this page does.

Each day without a top prize claim on "Platinum 7s", the remaining top prizes are spread across fewer unsold tickets. The number of tickets printed is fixed.

If you play "Platinum 7s" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
